patches: the tab's title and a description (the page is the site's shell for this design)
d3 vendored: cross-origin isolation blocks the d3js.org CDN
web_control.js only links to the darkui GUI, which does not exist on the web; web_page.js (the service worker for the isolation headers, the in-tab transport and the engine) takes its place

the transport: the page's socket is the in-tab SuperCollider engine (engine.js) instead of a WebSocket to viz/bridge.py; everything else in connect() is unchanged (the engine delivers `init` through ws.onmessage)
the profiles: the engine decodes data/profiles.u16 once (it also feeds SuperCollider from it); the page draws from the same Float32Array instead of fetching assets/profiles.f32
the title links to the about page: credits, data and licences (a new tab, so the sound keeps playing)
